name: Trigger.dev
summary: Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for running background tasks, scheduled jobs and long-running AI agents written in TypeScript. Tasks live in your codebase but execute on Trigger.dev's workers (cloud or self-hosted), with no execution timeout, retries, queues with concurrency limits, cron schedules and waitpoints that pause a run for human approval. A Realtime API streams run status and LLM output to the frontend.
facts: API calls, cron schedules with timezones, waitpoints
Free ($5 credits/mo); Hobby $10/mo; Pro $50/mo; compute billed per second
goodFor: Scheduled agent runs without managing cron servers
Long-running tasks that outlive serverless timeouts
Human-in-the-loop pauses that don't burn compute
watchOut: Tasks run on Trigger.dev workers, not in your own functions
Free tier stops when monthly credits run out
